description: Everything on the home page that the team can change without a developer: the logo, the category bar, the slider, the collection cards and the footer links.

fields.label: Logo
fields.description: Shown in the header. About 220x90. Leave empty for the built-in logo.

fields.label: Logo Description
fields.description: Read aloud by screen readers and used by search engines.

fields.label: Logo for Dark Backgrounds
fields.description: The white version, used in the footer. Leave empty to show the site name as text instead.

fields.label: Favicon
fields.description: The small icon in the browser tab. A square PNG, 32x32 or 64x64.

fields.label: Site Name
fields.description: Used in the tab title and link hints.

fields.label: Links
fields.description: The bar across the top of every page. Drag rows to reorder; untick Show to hide one without deleting it.

fields.label: Slides
fields.description: Drag rows to reorder.

fields.label: VAT Rate
fields.description: Set to 0 to show no tax line at all.

fields.label: Prices Already Include VAT
fields.description: Ticked (the Saudi retail norm): the price on the product page is what the customer pays, and the VAT line shows how much of it is tax. Unticked: VAT is added on top, and every total goes up.

fields.label: Pay by Card
fields.description: Needs the ClickPay keys in site config. Hidden automatically when they are missing.

fields.label: Bank Transfer
fields.description: The order is placed and an unpaid invoice is raised; your team confirms it once the money arrives.

fields.label: Transfer Instructions
fields.description: Shown on the order confirmation, under the bank details.

fields.label: Aramex Delivery (Without Installation)
fields.description: When ticked, a customer who picks Without installation chooses their city from Aramex's list, and Aramex's delivery price is added to each curtain. The Aramex account itself is set on the server (site_config.json), not here.

fields.label: Ship From City
fields.description: As Aramex spells it.

fields.label: Aramex Product Type
fields.description: The domestic service on Kayan's Aramex account. ONP is the one in Aramex's own samples; ask Aramex if unsure.

fields.label: Parcel Weight per m² (kg)
fields.description: A curtain's parcel weight is its area times this, packaging included.

fields.label: Order Notifications
fields.description: Who hears about a website order the moment it is placed or paid. Later status emails (order confirmed, invoice, delivery) are ERPNext Notifications named "Kayan: ...", and the customer emails' wording is in the Email Templates named "Kayan: ...".

fields.label: Alert Staff With Role
fields.description: Everyone with this role gets a bell notification in ERPNext for each new website order and payment.

fields.label: Also Email These Addresses
fields.description: Optional. One or more email addresses, separated by commas.

fields.label: Do Not Email Customers
fields.description: Tick to stop the order-received and payment-received emails to customers.

fields.label: Allow Checkout Without an Account
fields.description: Unticked, a customer must sign in before they can order. Their cart is kept either way.

fields.label: National Address Is Required
fields.description: The Saudi short address, e.g. RRRD2929. Businesses need it on an invoice; most private customers do not have it to hand.

fields.label: Hide This Section
fields.description: Removes the whole row of highlight boxes from the home page.

name: Curtain Storefront Settings
